verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a meaningful API surface. Reporting endpoints cover exceptions, source maps and deployments, a faults endpoint lists and fetches errors, and the official MCP server exposes project management, error investigation and BadgerQL Insights queries to agents. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches the UI, though: UI features such as alarm setup, integration configuration, account and team management, and fault resolution are only shown in UI or Slack contexts, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API coverage of UI-only features (alarms, integrations, team/account management, fault state changes), a published OpenAPI spec, any explicit API-parity claim, independent corroboration.
